# SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance

The **weekly scheduled review** of the suite itself: data freshness, broken/empty/slow panels, new resources not yet represented, coverage gaps, and proposed dashboard improvements - with versioning, approvals, and rollback. The agent keeps the observability surfaces healthy the same way it keeps the tenant healthy.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

## Workbook health at a glance

Open maintenance findings for the suite and their severity mix.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == 'SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance'
| where Status in ('New','Pending approval','Approved','In progress','Failed')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| summarize Findings = count() by Severity
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Open maintenance findings by severity

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == 'SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance'
| where Status in ('New','Pending approval','Approved','In progress','Failed')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| summarize Findings = count() by Category
content.title: Finding category mix

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance" and WorkbookPage == "Workbook Maintenance"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

content.json:
## Review cycle

The SRE Agent runs a weekly review (see `automation/weekly-review`). It writes findings to `SREAgentRecommendations_CL` with `WorkbookName = 'SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance'`, **auto-applies only low-risk metadata changes**, opens **PRs for medium/high-risk** definition changes, and requires **mandatory approval** for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes. Every change is versioned, validated, and reversible.

## Review status

When the last review ran, when the next is due, and which workbooks it covered.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == 'SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance'
| summarize LastReview = max(LastUpdated)
| extend NextReviewDue = LastReview + 7d
content.title: Last & next review

## Panel quality findings

Broken, empty, slow, or failing panels detected by the review. The work queue for keeping the suite trustworthy.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == 'SRE Agent Workbook Maintenance'
| where Category in ('Broken panel','Empty panel','Slow query','Query failure','Stale data source')
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| project Severity, Category, RecommendationText, AffectedScope, Status, RelatedPullRequest, LastUpdated
| order by Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
content.title: Open panel-quality recommendations

## Proposed & applied changes

What the agent wants to change, what it already auto-applied (low-risk), and what is waiting on approval.

| project Status, AgentActionType, ApprovalRequired, RecommendationText, RelatedPullRequest, RemediationRisk, RollbackAvailable, LastUpdated
| order by LastUpdated desc

## Versions, rollback & audit

Workbook version history, available rollback points, and the full audit trail of agent changes. Nothing the agent does is unauditable or irreversible.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ActionType has 'workbook'
| project StartedOn, ActionType, TargetResourceId, Outcome, Approver, RollbackAvailable, CompletedOn
| order by StartedOn desc
| take 100
content.title: Change audit trail

---
### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
